session_summary: A patient visited the doctor for persistent headaches, high blood pressure, and palpitations. The doctor prescribed medication, recommended lifestyle changes, and scheduled follow-up tests and appointments.

proposed_actions.title: Measure Blood Pressure
proposed_actions.description: Measure blood pressure twice daily and record values in a notebook
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: I want you to measure your blood pressure at home twice a day, in the morning and in the evening, and note the values in a notebook.

proposed_actions.title: Get Blood Tests
proposed_actions.description: Complete blood tests: cholesterol, blood sugar, creatinine, and ionogram
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: Please do them by Wednesday, on the spot.

proposed_actions.title: Schedule Electrocardiogram
proposed_actions.description: Undergo an electrocardiogram at the assistant's station
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: we'll do it right here, at the assistant, after the consultation.

proposed_actions.title: Take Amlodipine
proposed_actions.description: Take amlodipine five milligrams, one tablet in the morning
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: I'll prescribe you amlodipine five milligrams, one tablet in the morning.

proposed_actions.title: Follow Up Appointment
proposed_actions.description: Attend a follow-up appointment on Friday, November 13th at 10:00 AM
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: Come back on Friday, on the 13th of November, at ten o'clock.

decisions: Prescribe amlodipine five milligrams, one tablet in the morning
Schedule follow-up appointment on Friday, November 13th at 10:00 AM
risks: If blood pressure goes over 180 or symptoms like numbness, blurred vision, or chest pain occur, call 122 immediately
follow_up_questions: When will the blood pressure notebook be reviewed?
